heading: Form Issues
Adding Menu Items
replaces: The drawer renders top-level entries only as `group` or `item`, so a top-level custom entry typed `collapse` renders wrongly.
proposed: The drawer renders top-level entries only as `group` or `item`, so a top-level custom entry typed `collapse` renders wrongly. Group and item titles are translated with `t('menuTree.<title>', { defaultValue: title })`. The generator emits `menuTree.<label>` keys only for model navigation labels, so a group title created in a hook has no key and shows its English title in other locales. Known issue; workaround: add `"menuTree.<Group title>": "<translation>"` to each locale's application translation file for every title that a hook creates.
